findings.evidence: `rg -n "BoundedGenerator|Analysis.Semigroups"` shows only `code/TauCeti/Analysis/Semigroups/BoundedGenerator.lean:7` imports its dependencies, while `code/TauCeti/Analysis/Semigroups.lean:7` imports only `TauCeti.Analysis.Semigroups.Resolvent`.
findings.fix: Add a `public import TauCeti.Analysis.Semigroups.BoundedGenerator` to this umbrella module, alongside the existing `Resolvent` import.
findings.issue: The new public module `TauCeti.Analysis.Semigroups.BoundedGenerator` is not re-exported by the semigroups umbrella, so users importing `TauCeti.Analysis.Semigroups` do not get the advertised bounded-generator API.

findings.evidence: `BoundedGenerator.lean:89` has `ofBounded_apply` and `:94` has `ofBounded_realOperator_of_nonneg`, but `rg -n "ofBounded.*apply_apply|ofBounded_realOperator_apply"` has no hits; the existing constructor API has the missing parallel forms at `ExponentialShift.lean:70` and `:104`, and the roadmap uses bounded exponentials pointwise in Yosida estimates (`roadmap/TauCetiRoadmap/OneParameterSemigroups/README.md:130-133`).
findings.fix: Add `ofBounded_apply_apply (A) (t : ℝ≥0) (x : X)` and `ofBounded_realOperator_apply_of_nonneg (A) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (x : X)` restating lines 89-97 after applying to `x`.
findings.issue: `ofBounded` exposes only operator equalities; it lacks the pointwise characteristic lemmas needed for later estimates on `exp (t • A) x`, namely nonnegative-time and real-time apply forms.

summary: The bounded-generator constructor is not re-exported by the semigroups umbrella module, and its characteristic pointwise API is incomplete for downstream use. Fix these public-surface gaps before merging.
